Round 1 uses a 30-minute visible-turnaround upper bound in both arms. The original five weighted dimensions and 18-run design remain unchanged.
Secondary metrics: unnecessary-computation count/events, method-selection note/autonomy, reproducibility evidence items, and observable resource overhead. These do not alter the weighted Q score.
